data.desc: Invesco Ltd. is one of the world's leading asset management firms with 8,300 employees helping clients in more than 120 countries. With $2.4 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, we deliver a comprehensive range of active, passive and alternative investment capabilities. Our collaborative mindset, breadth of solutions and global scale mean we're well positioned to help retail and institutional investors rethink challenges and find new possibilities for success.
